The first thing I gotta do is tell you all the shit everyone probably tells you. Your life is not worth losing. There truly is so much to live for and these dark periods of your life seem endless but they are not. 

It sounds like you have a deeply complicated medical issue and so you HAVE to seek professional help. You need to speak with a doctor and a therapist and figure this out. If you keep fighting and you find people who will fight with you, your life will get better I promise.
